mcqs.q: Why did the Industrial Revolution begin in Britain?
options: Because Britain banned slavery before other countries.
Hitler called off the attack to invade the USSR immediately.
A combination of capital from trade and empire, coal and iron deposits, agricultural improvements, political stability, and a culture of invention.
Because James Watt invented the steam engine.
Slavery was abolished because cotton was no longer profitable.
Hitler called off the attack to invade the USSR immediately.
A combination of moral campaigning, slave resistance and rebellions (especially Haiti and Jamaica), and the shifting economic interest of industrial capitalism.
Wilberforce single-handedly persuaded Parliament to end slavery out of pure morality.
